shared_elements: upright monolithic block/pillar carrying carved decoration
a body with limbs rendered in low relief against the flat face of the stone
paired forelimbs/arms with splayed digits shown flat on the surface
vertically stacked zones of imagery on a tall surface
justification: Both show a tall upright block whose flat face bears figures modelled in shallow relief, with limbs ending in splayed digits laid flat against the surface and imagery stacked vertically, which is a broadly comparable convention but not a specific shared motif. A depicts a single massive anthropomorphic figure with headdress, folded arms, a chest disc and a belt band, while B depicts animals — a quadruped descending head-downward and a second creature below — with no human figure, disc or belt, so the actual subject matter differs almost entirely.
